title: refresh_effect: durationOverride without duration on item-power effect is accepted and silently not recorded
description: Found while repairing eshyra-o9bd.19.6.7.12 (A4-F1 declaration). In packages/core/src/state/activeEffects.ts refreshEffect, the item-power branch (itemBound defined) only checks durationProvenance when input.duration is supplied; with durationOverride and no duration the call returns ok:true and records nothing (probe in itemGrantSummons S5: provenance stays typed-fixed). The 'applies only to a duration bound to a printed item' guard only fires when itemBound is undefined. Decide whether to refuse such a call (fail closed) or document it. Runtime behaviour is unchanged by the declarative repair; declaration states the current behaviour.
